items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: when I first got the contract when Rick got me that contract

ctx.x: How does he keep up physically with what he does?

He’s very into his yoga and his thing that he does that way and all that stuff. And he’s a road rat. Road rats tend to be able to deal with the road and the turmoils and the physical stresses and that kind of stuff. You know I’m a heavy guy and everything else and our schedule with Dave is busy as hell. And yet you tend to deal with it. You figure it out and you make it work. He’s done well. I mean he’s in pretty good shape. He’s gained a little weight but — the last time I saw him I said, “It looks good on ya,…
